title: Your brain is 2% of you and burns 20% of your energy
teaser: Your brain is about 2% of your body weight but accounts for about 20% of the oxygen, and so the calories, your body uses. And hard thinking barely changes the total.

slides.alt: Reel cover: Brain Fact. A giant 20%. Of your body's oxygen goes to your brain. It's 2% of your weight.

body: Your brain is about 2% of your body weight. It accounts for about 20% of the oxygen, and so the calories, your body uses. That's around ten times what its weight alone would predict.

Here's the twist: thinking harder barely changes the total. Attempts to measure whole-brain changes in energy use during intense mental activity have failed to find any. Most of the energy goes on the brain's constant, ongoing signalling.
Your brain is never off. Send this to someone who says they're resting their brain.
forDesigners: A hard lesson doesn't drain a learner's brain the way a run drains muscles. Plan breaks for attention and practice, not to refuel.

sources.label: Raichle, M.E. & Gusnard, D.A. (2002). Appraising the brain's energy budget. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, 99(16), 10237–10239.
